reviews.text: If Balatro and Vampire Survivors had a kid who was reeeally into Picross. If you like Picross and have ever played a roguelike and thought "neat," you'll like this.

The balance on this game is bonkers. Mostly it's a boss problem. Here are two examples and I wouldn't recommend playing until some balance patches hit: - My first boss was The Shadow. 30% chance to hide clues. On most of the puzzles, it hid enough clues that I was simply forced to guess wildly to gain enough information to fill the puzzle. I might have had a really unlucky 30% but it was a misery and I only just barely survived. - My second boss on the next run left bombs (timers) on cells that counted down. This is mostly manageable and I was getting 5x5, 5x10, and 10x5 puzzles as a whittled the boss's health down. Then it spawned a 20x20 puzzle with at least a dozen bombs. Before I could even get my head around the puzzle all the bombs went off sequentially, killing me. Picross is generally about methodical puzzle solving. I'm here for a bit of gamification and I understand that the bosses are meant to be a challenge. However, being forced to guess wildly and being given very short timers on a large puzzle that are solve-or-die really ruins the experience. You get items throughout your run that allow you to cheat (reveal hidden cells automatically, regain health, do extra damage, gain extra time). The game needs to be balanced in a way that doesn't put you in an unwinnable situation before you can become strong enough to handle it.

My first run, I became an immortal god who sold infinite amounts of golden fish to automatically solve everything for me. The game quickly devolves into you not having to care about getting anything right or wrong on any of the puzzles, and more about how quickly you want to develop RSI. It's fun, but it REALLY needs to be better balanced (and optimised, the game freezing for 10-20 seconds each shop in endless mode isn't great).
Opened the game and was given a 20x20 puzzle for the very first stage 10/10
I didn't know what pain and despair was until I fought a late game Leech.

I got to a point where the game refused to run because I could simply sell fish to win every match, lagging the game until it took ~10 minutes to finish a level, ending at Floor 12. There's an achievement for beating Floor 15. I'm going to supplement this review after playing about 15 more hours and actually getting that achievement: The core problem is that the amount of items you're getting makes every run of the game feel the same. Not only that, every run at higher difficulties has a *lot* of wasted time. Because of how the items work in this, by floor 6, you're healing for more than you ever take damage for, making it im possib le to lose. At that point, you'd think you'd win, right? Except every difficulty adds another floor to the run, making runs go for so much longer than is actually necessary to check skill. It's a fun idea, but the balance makes the game tedious instead of challenging.
cant recommend without big changes such a good concept and really fun, but get rid of some of these bosses, seriously anti-fun to have my screen flip upside down every 15 seconds

同样没中文的roguelike扫雷玩了一百多小时，于是这个游戏一发售就立刻赶来入库评测（。 语言： 英文不多，主要是教程和遗物描述。教程内容不重要，和常规数织基本一样，只是多了rogue的部分。 加入了遗物、消耗品、剩余时长、时间流速、血量和金钱的影响。其中遗物和消耗品的描述比较重要，还有boss的技能描述，如果查了字典也看不懂那应该是玩不下去的。 加入中文的难点估计有一部分在字体适配上…… 界面： 比较阴暗，说实话配上这个字体有点费眼睛…… 界面很简单，不过这个风格下，continue键真的需要“找”，可谓是相当不醒目了。 毕竟是鼠标操作，比起触屏玩这类游戏还是稍显僵硬。又因为rogue的限时要素，不像手游的数织游戏会给玩家超智能的补全行/列的功能（而是放在了遗物里），玩起来不算太休闲。 左键填入、右键填X、中键标记，和扫雷基本逻辑一致，用起来应该都能习惯。 以及如果有人关心的话，抽遗物的老虎机拉杆需要“点击”，而不是“拖动“（。 游玩： 这个限时还是有点奇葩的……低难度的图也就算了，如果开局想直接走难度高的图，时间应该是来不及的（或许大神可以，反正我选择截图暂停一条龙……） 但遗物成型后又微妙地不需要担心了…… 截至5小时左右的体验是这样，之后加入新职业、新挑战后或许有出入。 平衡显然就那样，有些遗物强，有些遗物弱，还有些遗物看起来不错但可能副作用更气人…… boss词条也是，有些极其烦人，有些就友善得多。比如每隔几秒给你洗掉一个已填好的格子，看起来平平无奇，实际体感比在你干活时阻止你用电脑的猫猫还烦=_= 个人目前觉得最重要的是路线图上的时间回廊商店，可以购买降低时间流速的消耗品，降完之后终于感觉回到“益智游戏”的范畴了…… 自动补全行/列和随机揭示格子、揭示附近格子之类的当然非常舒服，大幅降低填图时间，也许走这个流派就无需纠结局内限时和现实的游玩时间，可以快速来几盘？ 血量压力不大，稍微拿点遗物就能回上来，毕竟最容易掉血的部分是手抖点错（。 新解锁的职业我大概看了下，自带某些遗物，经验获取、默认时间流速、默认难度都有所不同，不过目前看来内容并不算丰富，这个价格可能不算有性价比…… 不足： 1，快捷键基本等于没有。esc键都没适配多少有点无语了。 2，疑似bug，好几次遇到结算页面给的消耗品无法放进背包，只能扔掉或者点skip。并且这种情况下，即使选择摧毁结算时给的消耗品，也显示skip而不是continue。进无尽模式后打着打着莫名其妙又好了，但已经让我养成了不依赖消耗品的好习惯（。 3，没有存盘。我不是要求你出普通存盘，但打无尽模式打了三小时了，准备下游戏了，你告诉我这一局完全不会保存…… 你是无尽模式还是游戏马拉松啊？至少给个下次进入时继续之前的进度吧？ 4，内容略少，希望以后能有更多的更新和补充吧。 5，虽然还好，但被boss骚扰和赶时间的玩法给人的观感不佳。大型数织图可以给予玩家优秀的心流体验，这些干扰项却会让人频繁分心、注意力数度中断。 所以虽然这是一个好评，但我只推荐非常喜欢数织及类似的rogue游戏体验的玩家购买。 ———————— 二次编辑： 决定改为差评。 因为我发现我回去玩传统数织时也变得追求速度、不再在乎犯错了，这问题比游戏不好玩更严重。 依然只推荐非常喜欢数织及rogue体验的玩家购买，并且重点在于后者。

因为才把数织画家通了被购物车推荐了这个，这个价钱来讲还算满意，能把数织和肉鸽地下城揉一起听神秘的。 优点来说UI的质感不错，老虎机和转盘也挺有趣，也有很多小巧思让人耳目一新。有很多奇怪的combo能在这个游戏里通过遗物用出来。 没有中文，但是鉴于文本量不大，有英文基础问题不会很多。 不太能接受的地方也有一些。首先是游戏机制本身就有点左右脑互搏，安静的拼图游戏加了时间限制就有点压力大，简单的还好，难度等级4就开始有点看不清还滴滴滴倒计时的时候心态是真的炸裂。然后有的关卡没有很明显的切入点，曾经开过五级图，然后都是小数字，用血量生创命丧当场。 昨晚第一次玩，无尽模式到了5层都50分钟了，看到成就里不知道是不是要到12层就感到害怕。但是确实可以入手来玩。

Game is fun, but it's as much about RNG as it is about intelligence. At the higher levels, you are literally playing pattern recognition, educated guessing, and a willingness to lose health. There's no other way to kill these giant puzzles in the time limit otherwise.

I'm a huge fan of picross / nonograms, and mixing that with a roguelike progression system is extremely addictive. I loved the demo of this game I played a few months ago, and the finished version has fixed a handful of quality-of-life issues I had with the demo. It's *excellent* now. I'll probably revisit this review after a few more runs, seeing how the roguelike systems evolve, but it's an easy recommendation already.

以数织（Nonogram aka. Picross）为基础的rougelite游戏，使用遗物（Arrifact）和道具（Item）辅助解题，选择路线以遇到不同的事件（Place），最终击败每层拥有特殊技能的首领（Boss）。 游戏前可以选择不同的角色（不共享经验值）和难度（每个角色分开解锁），通过难度对应的层数后可以开启无尽模式。 游戏难度还算合理，所有常规盘面都能逻辑解，后期甚至不用手填一个格子就能完成盘面，但是也要面对血量膨胀极快的Boss和优化问题导致的卡顿。 整体来说很推荐。

Needs either gameplay revision or major balance changes. Most higher floor runs succeed via making the time a nonfactor with a 0x multiplier and then getting enough random relics to where you actually get more out of making mistakes and taking damage than actually solving the puzzles. It's a good concept for a game but the execution needs to be looked at again. I would love for this to work but it really doesn't in it's current state.

Difficulty scaling seems bugged maybe? Frequently run into 15x15 tables on my first stage. Even using a machine solver and the pause button I still can't clear those in the time allotted. Similarly I get more chances to expand my inventory or sacrifice an item than I do item drops. The game could be cool if they tuned it, but right now it's mostly just a neat idea. Skip for now, come back in 6 months.

I played 7 hours of this the first day I bought it. I absolutely love the concept, the style, the whole deal. My only real complaint about it is that so far, it seems too easy. When i play the endless mode of this game, I outscale it so quickly I don't think the rounds would ever catch up to me - whereas I play something like balatro, I'm only going to get through 2 or 3 rounds of endless mode unless im really lucky with my build. Up the difficulty scale in general, or at least in endless mode, and I'd be obsessed. Great game regardless!

I really hate to give this a bad review because this is an incredible idea that I wish had been done sooner, but the execution really falls apart. The game at first seems very interesting, it has a good variety of items and artifacts that seem to cater to different play styles. It has a cool retro aesthetic. But once you dig a little deeper things don't seem as rosy. The game seems to do a lot to cater to people who might be new to picross puzzles, to the point where at a sufficiently high level you can get the game to more or less play itself (there's even an achievement for that.) To a certain point it almost becomes a better option to just not bother with the puzzles at all. as In my difficulty 11 run I eventually got to a point where it was faster and easier to just randomly click squares hoping to make mistakes so the boards would solve themselves. The fact that I was so annoyed by the rest of the game's trappings that I was intentionally not solving puzzles just to get to the end faster is really the main reason why I can't recommend this game. For a game that really forces you to blow through puzzles as fast as possible, it really doesn't respect your time at all. The level end screen requires you to watch the slot machine spin every single time, even when you're well past the point that another level in one of your artifacts is going to make any difference to the outcome of the game. All the animations in the game take far too long, they might be cool once but not when you hit the grind the game inevitably becomes. And a grind it truly is. The way the difficulty scaling works means you have to complete entire games at every difficulty to unlock the next one, which led to me spending tens of hours just going through the motions, watching that roulette wheel spin until the game presented any sort of challenge... and the challenge I got was basically just re-rolling runs until I got the right set of artifacts that instantly made the game trivially easy again. While there is an achievement for finishing a run at difficulty 12, it would probably require me to spend at least 8 hours letting the slot machine roll and having the drawn out death animation play before I hit the right combination of artifacts to get anywhere and at this point I'd rather do literally anything else with my time. This game generally exists in a really weird space in the realm of picross games. As I complain about how the game is incredibly easy right up until it isn't, the game has gotten numerous balance patches that have made the bosses easier. I haven't even brought up the bosses because with the exception of one or two that actually make things interesting, like the one that makes the clues show where the crosses should be, the bosses just weren't an issue. Which makes me think maybe I'm just not the intended audience, or maybe picross as a concept just doesn't really work as a base for a rougelike because of the skill gap. It's interesting that where most modern picross games intentionally remove time as a game mechanic, time ends up being the main thing that this game ends up focusing on. I don't think it works, especially since it focuses on time to the detriment of everything else. As mentioned before all the puzzles are randomly generated and the fact the game just instantly removes them after you complete them tells me the devs don't care about any of the puzzles themselves either. The sound design is just awful. The various passive powerups end up layering their lo-fi noises on top of each other as you play, the level end screen becomes a total cacophony once you get into longer runs and the singular UI noise sounds so dull and uninspired going up a minor third, it sounds like even the game itself doesn't even want to be there. Yeah man I dunno, it's a tough problem to solve, and honestly there's probably a good reason why nobody's made a picross rougelike before. But this ain't it.
A+

经典数织加肉鸽地牢，看似两个八竿子打不到一起的玩法给融合到了一起，在上手玩之前是完全想象不出这要怎么玩。我是因为各种扫雷玩了一大堆，想着数织应该也没啥问题，玩了之后感觉游戏还是有些割裂的。 数织谜题就是根据数字提示来在横向纵向填入相应数字，原本这是需要逻辑推理进行横向纵向进行校验后，再进行填写，但是游戏为了增加能力维度引入了倒计时和血量，倒计时到0之后并不会立即判负，而是会不断扣除血量，只有当生命值为0时才会导致游戏失败。扣除生命值除了会受倒计时影响，如果格子点击错误也是会扣血，这样就需要仔细地去进行推理，一开始格子数比较少凭借一些固定的数字分布还能快速填入，但格子数一多那就要慢下来，但一旦慢下来倒计时不够就会导致一轮比一轮紧张，恶性循环下去直到血量扣完。如果时间不够，那只会越来越不够，反之如果时间足够，那怎么玩都不会不够，反而会越来越多，这样的情况就需要道具和神器来进行平衡，一方面可以提高填入格子的效率，另一方面可以减缓时间的衰减以及增加回血的效果，如此一来数织谜题本身就变得没那么重要了，只要道具够，闭眼随便填都没事，Boss战倒是挺有意思，也是难为作者在不多的维度中想出那么多额外的效果。但无论怎样，始终都没办法平衡好数织谜题和肉鸽构筑之间的关系，一头失衡容易让游戏进入到两个截然相反的极端，这无论是对于数织爱好者还是肉鸽玩家两头不讨好，这叫什么呀，一根筋两头堵，就说难受不难受吧。 [quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/laoshirenLSR]老实人评测[/url]：独立游戏爱好者聚集地，黄油绅士交流中心。 不错过游戏的亮点，不放过游戏的槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote]

undoubtedly the most unique picross game I've ever played. it's a lot more pressure than a traditional picross game. highly recommended giving at least the demo a go even if you prefer more relaxed puzzle games.

I really like this game. The structure it uses is well worn but maps great to nonograms. Having time pressure and upgrades during a picross style game is novel. The bosses have fun mechanics that force you to switch up the rhythm you can get into when doing lots of puzzles in a row. My one criticism is that it feels too easy to stock up on time based powerups that make the countdown neglibile. That can sand off one of the core appeals of the game. Cool game though, glad I bought it!

This is great if you love the mechanics of picross and are a fan of roguelikes. My only complaint is that each run gets easier the further you go, which is in opposition to traditional roguelike behavior. Certain items are simply too powerful when stacked and combined, which leads to shenanigans like "use a gold fish to mark roughly a dozen spots as gold, which causes an explosion of 20 random cells, of which one explodes the surrounding 9, and all exploded cells have a 5% chance of clearing the entire column they are in. Oh, and for every 3 of those gold cells, if you correctly mark them before they expire you get another free goldfish." And every sufficiently long run (of 7+ floors) ends up this way, and my last 9 floor run ended with 40k gold and 1300 HOURS of clock time available to me. If you don't go in expecting something deep like Balatro you will enjoy yourself. As someone who itches for more picross, this is a wonderful change of pace, but I really wish higher difficulties did more than increase starting penalties. All the difficulty modifiers are basically negligible to eradicate by the end of floor 3.

A lot of fun, if you like Picross-style puzzles. I thought I was pretty good at them and getting kind of bored of clones, but the additional mechanics in this add whole new levels to the gameplay. It felt a bit like starting all over, in a good way.

Hubris is a noun that means "an extreme arrogance or unwarranted self-confidence". In fiction, hubris is often the hallmark of a tragic hero whose sordid tale is one of strength and glory, with pride coming before a fall. It could also be a villainous trait, for one whose successes in the early acts lead to an inattentive state wherein he is hoisted on his own petard in the finale. Hubris takes many forms. Consumers of fiction often point to hubris as an enjoyable theme to see, if not its mechanism of action, the results of, when critiquing literature. Outside of fiction one might have hubris, or be hubristic, if they believe something about themselves, such as "I can solve the nonogram puzzles in CiniCross without using any of the Roguelike elements which the game provides me", or "I am able to solve the level 5 puzzle on the first floor of the dungeon in under three minutes", that is provably untrue. They might have reason to believe or evidence to suggest that their confidence is warranted, such as "I solved every puzzle in Mario's Picross for the Game Boy and Mario's Super Picross for the Super Famicom", or perhaps "I've done hundreds of puzzles in 2025 Picross Game Of The Year, Squeakcross: Home Squeak Home". As with the heroes and villains that engaged in hubris in classical and renaissance fiction, a nonogram aficionado or enthusiast who chooses to play a nonogram-themed roguelike dungeon-crawling puzzle game like CiniCross may place gravely mistaken faith in his capabilities and be subjected to firm embarrassment leading to an ironic fate, usually resulting in his death. on an unrelated note using the 25 block fill item on floor 1 isn't a good idea

Although the recent changes made it even more difficult, I think its part of the growing pains of any game thats still finding to find it footing. The developer clearly cares a lot about balance, and to keep the game from getting stale, which I whole-heartedly welcome. Also the gambling element for items is just so much fun. Also please add plinko as an additional element. Maybe as a level to reach during a run where you can throw an item into the plinko and either get an upgrade out of it, or nothing.

中评。 肉鸽+数织，先上总结：两边不讨好……肉鸽选手苦于织，数织选手本职技能发挥不了多少……全靠天意！ 我自诩数织大王（因为外号都是纺织厂厂长来着~）想着这游戏我不得so easy！结果玩得也挺难受的…… 初期职业没解锁几个，走到3层都感觉吃力，随到特别大的图就很讨厌，不是织不出来，而是道具buff过于看脸，主要时间太紧，急促让人体验感很不好！！和计时还不一样，它到后面时间的速率递增有点离谱，大概15×15，给你一分钟这还算好的，有一些关是10×10，但是一关让你织4个图……boss里面我最恶心的是那个不能打×的，大图不能打x极其不爽！ 后来我用减时速+掉血自动答+堆血量过了15关（后面其实我可以无限继续打，有这三基本就是无脑过了，只是成就只到15关所以我收手了） 这个过纯靠组道具，和数织实力毫无关系，哪怕你很能织也不大可能比如一关让你织4张20×20的在那么短时间内，必须道具，因此数织失去了本身的意义。 后期我都是一顿瞎点（因为我靠伤血触发自动织）无聊的看满屏爆炸…… 成就党想全应该不太容易，而且没法随玩随停，只有打过单关的boss才有存档。 性价比一般，喜欢数织的朋友我反而不太建议买这个。

For now I can't recommend because you will have a mix of frustration and addiction. The game needs quite a lot of polishing in terms of QoL, UX, bugs for the Steam Deck and balancing. the game will get better but wait another semester or more. the main issue is that you cannot save during a run. So you have to fully clear a dozen of grids before being allowed to save your progression at the end of a level (similar to a chapter in Binding of Isaac). So the next issue is a follow up to that lack of saving option: you are more incline to play on your Steam Deck since you can stop the game and resume at any time. But the user experience and inputs for the Steam Deck are awful and come with some bugs which can ruin a run (overlapping item and unusable slot). Second issue, similar to the saving one: when you launch a run, you cannot change anything in the options. you need to exit and restart a run if you want to change the music volume of instance. If your display has an issue, and you need to change the resolution, you shall restart. About the UI/UX, when actually gaming on a grid you can’t pause to check your inventory: icons are displayed but if you want to refresh your memory about what an item does and so what is triggering its power, you have to wait until the end of your grid… or mouse over the item and loose those precious seconds. Perfect segway to the next issue: difficulty due to the timer. The game can ask you to fulfil huge grids and the game is designed so that when you need to fulfil such grids, you have many passive items which will be triggered and auto complete 2/3 of the grid in the end. But you also can have them earlier in your run, so with way less item: that’s a huge waste of time and very likely an end of run even before you play the grid. The game has a pacifist option which disable entirely the death by the timer. And then the game shift from too hard to very easy. and so many other issues: no restart button, loosing a run redirects you on the main page and not on the “Launch run” page, when loosing you can’t skip the animation… generally speaking it feels like the game had to released at a certain day, but lot’s of Quality related issues were not resolved… but then I saw that a developer said in February that a proper Save system will be implemented and here we are more than 4 months after without it. So the game will get better but wait another semester or more.

Developer Hydrobates takes the familiar concept of nonogram puzzles and reshapes it into something far more adventurous with CiniCross, a title that blends logical deduction with roguelite progression in an unexpectedly natural way. Published by Hydrobates as well, the game abandons the calm, meditative pace commonly associated with picross-inspired experiences and instead places players inside a dangerous dungeon where every completed puzzle represents another step toward survival. Rather than existing as isolated brain teasers, the nonograms become the primary mechanic that drives exploration, progression, and decision-making, resulting in a hybrid that feels refreshingly different from both traditional puzzle games and standard roguelites. At its core, CiniCross revolves around procedurally generated nonogram challenges that steadily grow in size and complexity throughout each expedition. Players begin with smaller grids that introduce the mechanics before gradually facing much larger and more demanding puzzles that require careful concentration and logical thinking. The dungeon itself branches into multiple routes, encouraging players to make meaningful choices about where to travel next. Along the way, special locations such as merchants, campfires, and treasure-filled rooms provide opportunities to prepare for increasingly difficult encounters. Since every journey is randomly generated, each run presents different puzzle layouts, rewards, and strategic decisions, giving the game a high level of replayability that keeps repeated attempts engaging rather than repetitive. A major highlight of the experience is the wide variety of artifacts and passive abilities that players can collect during their adventures. These relics introduce gameplay modifiers that can dramatically alter how puzzles are solved by granting useful advantages or changing the overall flow of each run. Some powers improve efficiency, while others create opportunities for unique combinations that encourage experimentation with different strategies. Building effective synergies becomes just as important as solving the puzzles themselves, adding another layer of depth beyond simple logical deduction. This progression system successfully captures the addictive "one more run" feeling that defines many successful roguelites while ensuring that puzzle-solving always remains the centerpiece of the experience. The game's presentation supports its atmosphere with charming pixel art that balances fantasy adventure and mysterious dungeon exploration. Dark environments, strange creatures, and imposing bosses create a sense of tension without overshadowing the clean readability required for puzzle gameplay. Boss encounters are particularly noteworthy because they introduce fresh mechanics instead of relying solely on tougher puzzles, ensuring that major milestones feel memorable and require players to adapt their approach. The combination of visual charm, atmospheric environments, and evolving gameplay mechanics helps maintain momentum throughout each run. CiniCross also embraces the roguelite philosophy of learning through failure. Defeat is never simply a setback but an opportunity to improve future attempts by understanding puzzle patterns, experimenting with different artifact combinations, and making smarter strategic decisions. This creates a rewarding sense of progression for players who enjoy mastering complex systems over time. However, newcomers looking for a purely relaxing nonogram experience may find the added pressure, increasing difficulty, and roguelite structure more demanding than expected. The larger puzzle grids and layered mechanics require patience and focus, especially during later stages where every mistake can have lasting consequences. Overall, CiniCross is a remarkably creative fusion of two genres that rarely intersect, successfully transforming classic nonogram gameplay into an engaging roguelite adventure. Its procedural progression, meaningful decision-making, diverse artifact system, and steadily escalating challenges create a satisfying gameplay loop that rewards both careful planning and logical thinking. While its difficulty may not appeal to every puzzle enthusiast, players seeking an innovative experience that goes beyond traditional nonogram games will likely find plenty to appreciate. By confidently combining strategic dungeon exploration with rewarding puzzle mechanics, Hydrobates has crafted a distinctive title that stands out in both genres. Rating: 8/10

结论来说，确实不算一款好的picross，但上头也是确实上头，不耐玩也确实不耐玩。 作为picross来说，首先填错有惩罚且填对的无法再次消除，对于解picross习惯不太标准的玩家来说那就是各种卡手。同时，手柄操作可以说非常糟糕了，光标移动速度慢，没有循环光标功能，而且也不能改键位。至于谜题质量就更不用说，要么简单过头，要么复杂过头，有些谜题能否以常规思路解谜（反复找共性，偶尔需要排除法，不需要依赖揭秘功能）都是个问题。 但是作为肉鸽来说，那倒是确实上头。毕竟谁能想到picross都能搞出个技能picross来呢？早期挑选低难度谜题解开，积攒artifact后逐渐自动解谜概率越来越高，这时即使高难度谜题也能自动解掉一大部分，难度骤降，低难度谜题甚至有概率自动全解。甚至到更后期，有可能连填错扣血这个惩罚都不是问题了，可以硬抗，甚至有些artifact还必须靠填错来触发，那么结果就是不知道怎么做时直接填一排就完事。当然，这么个技能picross显然已经和传统picross没太大关系了，但是嘛，爽就完了。 而且至少在这么个技能picross里，玩家自身的传统picross能力还是有一定作用的，能力强的玩家能在数值不太够时给自己换取一定的优势，数值高了之后也能更快触发各种技能，通关概率自然比不擅长picross的玩家要更高。至于如果有玩家抱怨，不擅长解谜的话会很吃亏，那不擅长动作游戏的玩家去玩动作肉鸽不也一样吃亏吗？只能说彼此彼此罢了。而游戏手柄手感差这个问题也被极其流畅的鼠标操作给弥补了，倒不如说这游戏本就应该用鼠标来玩的。哪怕是在steamdeck上也应该用触控板而不是手柄。（话说反而NS商店上搜不到。。。虽然NS不太适合玩，但起码NS2标配鼠标啊，多少有点可惜了。） 最后，关于为什么不耐玩，因为以上我描述的游玩方式基本上就是唯一可行的游玩方式了。甚至这游戏里做build的意义都不大，因为前几层楼对于擅长picross的玩家来说，只要不太非，用什么都能通关，而后面的楼层基本上所有东西都拿了一遍了，自然也就不存在build了。而且这游戏楼层高了之后boss血量膨胀十分离谱，但是玩家能造成的伤害又没跟着膨胀，难度方面也被自动解谜机制压得没有策略性了，基本上就是无聊的砍树过程。极端点说，目前的状况，当你第一次打通第15层后，你会再也不想打开这个游戏了，因为感觉很难再遇到新东西了。

I'm a big Picross head. Hundreds if not thousands of hours across the DS and 3DS games and the various nonogram games on Steam. What I really, really like about Picross is the feeling of methodically untangling a nonogram's knot. CiniCross is not built around that. It rewards speed above all else, and late enough in a given run, it is basically solving the puzzles for you. I frequently found myself just quitting the game before letting an endless run reach its logical conclusion, because I was bored. This game takes everything I love about nonogram puzzles and replaces it with flashy juicy noise. I played through just long enough to unlock every class and get up to like difficulty 7, and then put it down. It's not for me.
